content_of_post_to_answer: Is the fear of rejection a common theme in your life?
answer: Fear of rejection is often less about hearing “no” and more about what we believe that “no” says about us. A useful distinction is between rejection and interpretation: one is an event, the other is the story we attach to it. I've explored this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone who wants to look deeper. The surprising part is that avoiding rejection can quietly become a rejection of your own possibilities.
